reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 04 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution profile/collar crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

entries.positive_observation: The field-gray/olive peaked cap with gold front insignia and gold visor ornament remains, with hair mostly covered and a clean-shaven smooth chin without a moustache or beard. The distinctive near-profile still faces and gazes toward viewer left: the cap brim and single closed mouth point left, the far eye is reduced to a narrow edge exposure and the broad near cheek dominates. It has not been rotated into a symmetrical frontal face. Three-quarter shoulders, chest-up crop, directional facial modeling and cap-brim shadow remain. The uniform retains two red collar patches with gold details, one visible gold-edged shoulder board, and one pale blue-and-white neck ribbon with a small silver-toned throat decoration. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk, clipping or cream bib. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque muted gray-olive photographic backing, overlapping warm-cream note with compact upper gray marks and mostly blank lower paper, and small right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte outer ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette. Actual white/cyan/alpha inspection found no visible holes or missing backing; 252-254 alpha values were not used as a rejection shortcut. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: At 65x67 the exact cap, collar and neck-decoration symbols are too small to transcribe; their visible metallic colors, placements and counts were checked without claiming microscopic emblem identity. The note's gray marks remain indistinct shapes rather than readable text.
